name: Ariful Islam
headline: Associate Lead – Software Development | Azure · AWS · On-Premises | Kubernetes (AKS) | .NET · React
about: Cloud engineer and Associate Lead with 9+ years building cloud-native systems in .NET, React and Angular. Designs, deploys and runs microservices on Azure (private AKS, Container Apps), AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS) and customer on-premises data centres, using infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform), GitHub Actions CI/CD and private networking. Specialist in SCIM and Entra ID identity integration, leading teams that deliver secure, scalable platforms across finance, education and transportation.
